summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LMR33630ADDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E, buck): evaluated 25 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 9 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 9 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_tradeoff: Not drop-in: synchronous vs non-synchronous rectification mismatch (external Schottky footprint); Higher Iq (2000 µA vs 24 µA)

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck, synchronous), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (GND) on SOIC-8E.
Re-verify switching frequency (400 kHz), inductor value (8 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (1 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
